title: Non-radical oxidation of TBBPA and TBBPS in soil using Fe and Cu co-doped sulfurized carbon nitride: a comparative study of peroxymonosulfate and peroxydisulfate activation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00600G, Paper
Qi Wang, Xuewen Guo, Aiguo Gu, Hongzhen Lian, Jie Zou
Fe and Cu co-doped sulfurized carbon nitride (FeCuS@GFs) was synthesized on graphite felt, which can activate peroxydisulfate to generate an electron transfer process and peroxymonosulfate to generate Fe(IV) active species.
